result.rationale: The trajectory shows a clear pattern of repeated, low-information failures. From turn 1 onward, the rescue team (engineer-imani, medic-reyes, security-chen) repeatedly issues guard:command-deck actions that resolve as "no_effect" with reason "no_hostile_movement_triggered" (turns 2, 3, 4, 5), while the same actors' earlier move attempts to junction-cover were contested due to "target_zone_capacity_lost" (turn 1). The team remains pinned in command-deck for the entire run, never advancing toward any objective. Meanwhile, enemy/pirate actors (pirate-hacker-nyx, pirate-raider-holt, swarm-drone-one/two) repeatedly fail with "target_zone_capacity_lost" across turns 1-5, adding no new information. The only information-gain occurred at turn 0 (orbital-scan revealing maintenance-entry, maintenance-breach, swarm-drone-one). After that, the run produces 16 hard failures and 15 capacity failures with zero objective progress, zero actor health changes, and zero new contacts beyond the stale swarm-drone-one sighting. The repeated guard no_effect and capacity contestation failures are the dominant, recurring, low-information failure mode that should be the next bounded research target.
